
I would like you to reverse engineer a gate-level netlist back to its original RTL description.
The netlist was synthesized from a Verilog RTL design.

Please create an equivalent, clean, and readable RTL description that implements the same functionality.
Your RTL should be written in standard Verilog or SystemVerilog using best practices.

The module should be named 'TopModule' with the following interface:
mode, too_cold, too_hot, fan_on, heater, aircon, fan

Gate-level netlist:
```verilog
/* Generated by Yosys 0.51 (git sha1 c4b5190229616f7ebf8197f43990b4429de3e420, g++ 14.2.0-4ubuntu2 -fPIC -O3) */

module RefModule(mode, too_cold, too_hot, fan_on, heater, aircon, fan);
  wire _00_;
  wire _01_;
  wire _02_;
  wire _03_;
  output aircon;
  wire aircon;
  output fan;
  wire fan;
  input fan_on;
  wire fan_on;
  output heater;
  wire heater;
  input mode;
  wire mode;
  input too_cold;
  wire too_cold;
  input too_hot;
  wire too_hot;
  NOT _04_ (
    .A(too_cold),
    .Y(_02_)
  );
  NOT _05_ (
    .A(mode),
    .Y(_03_)
  );
  NAND _06_ (
    .A(too_hot),
    .B(_03_),
    .Y(_00_)
  );
  NOT _07_ (
    .A(_00_),
    .Y(aircon)
  );
  NOR _08_ (
    .A(_02_),
    .B(_03_),
    .Y(heater)
  );
  NOR _09_ (
    .A(fan_on),
    .B(heater),
    .Y(_01_)
  );
  NAND _10_ (
    .A(_00_),
    .B(_01_),
    .Y(fan)
  );
endmodule

```
